sentences.en: "It's open-faced. " Tyrion pinched her nose. "I am fond of looking at your nose. I would rather that you kept it. "

sentences.en: The feast is finished off with open-faced apple tart with vanilla ice-cream,(sentencedict .com) putting your taste buds on a perfect trip to France.
